Let me analyze the query description:

- n_windows: 48 windows
- Features:
  - variance_log_ratio: mean 0.0577, std 0.6109, trend 0.074 (slightly increasing)
  - ac1: mean 0.5225, std 0.1188, trend -0.1598 (decreasing autocorrelation)
  - skewness: mean 0.1097, std 0.4426, trend 0.7356 (strongly increasing skewness)
  - kurtosis: mean 0.167, std 0.5566, trend -0.0429 (slightly decreasing)
  - trend_slope: mean -0.3225, std 1.3791, trend -0.9934 (strongly decreasing trend slope)
  - tau_variance: mean 0.039, std 0.4169, trend 0.1154 (slightly increasing)
  - tau_ac1: mean 0.0475, std 0.364, trend -0.0561 (slightly decreasing)
  - low_freq_power: mean 0.4934, std 0.1294, trend -0.1008 (decreasing low frequency power)

The trends show some concerning patterns:
- skewness trend is strongly positive (0.7356) - increasing skewness can be an early warning signal
- trend_slope trend is strongly negative (-0.9934) - the trend is becoming more negative
- ac1 trend is negative (-0.1598) - decreasing autocorrelation (though typically increasing AC1 is a warning sign)
- low_freq_power trend is negative (-0.1008)

Now I should run the PFN model to get predictions.
